description: This file defines the interface `GlobalConfigurationWritePlatformService` which provides methods for updating global configurations and adding survey configurations within the Fineract platform. It is part of the infrastructure configuration service layer.

classes.name: GlobalConfigurationWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface for services that handle write operations related to global configurations and survey configurations in the platform.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a global configuration identified by `configId` using the provided `JsonCommand`.

methods.name: addSurveyConfig
methods.description: Adds a new survey configuration with the specified `name`.
